description.value: The study investigated brain activation patterns and cue reactivity to gambling and smoking pictures in treatment-seeking problem gamblers, heavy smokers and healthy controls, including relationships between cue-related activation and subjective craving.

spans.text: In the present study, we wanted to address these issues by investigating brain activation patterns to gambling or smoking cues in chronic PRGs seeking treatment, heavy smokers (HSM) and non-smoking non-gambling healthy controls (HC).

design.value: A functional magnetic resonance imaging event-related cue reactivity paradigm consisting of gambling, smoking-related, neutral and low-level baseline pictures was administered to treatment-seeking PRG, HSM and HC, with whole-brain group-interaction and craving-correlation analyses.

spans.text: A functional magnetic resonance imaging event-related cue reactivity paradigm, consisting of gambling, smoking-related and neutral pictures, was employed in 17 treatment-seeking non-smoking PRG, 18 non-gambling HSM, and 17 non-gambling and non-smoking HC.
